create.name: Jerri Doran
create.bio:
Jerri Doran is a shamanic practitioner and teacher based in Salida, in the mountains of central Colorado, where she works under the name Shamanwings Healing. Her spiritual search began in 1990 and led her through several healing paths before she started training in the Medicine Wheel in 2007. She works in the Andean Q'ero tradition of Peru, in which she has received initiation as a priestess and wisdomkeeper, and names Ginger Lee and Clarke St. Dennis as her main teachers, in a lineage that includes Don Antonio and Alberto Villoldo. Travel to sacred sites such as Machu Picchu, Ausangate and Chaco Canyon is part of her practice.

She teaches in person near Salida: one-day introductions to shamanism and to shamanic journeying, each closing with a fire ceremony, and a two-year Medicine Wheel programme of weekend workshops in which students receive initiations, build a medicine bundle and learn ceremonial work. She also offers private shamanic sessions, in person or by phone, as well as land and house clearings and ceremonies for weddings and for the dying. Her recorded journeys to the lower and upper worlds, with rattle and drum tracks, are free on YouTube and Insight Timer, and she appears at holistic fairs around Colorado.

courses.title: Medicine Wheel Series
courses.description: A training in the Q'ero tradition held over ten weekends across about two years near Salida. Students move through the four directions of the wheel, receive a series of initiations, build a personal medicine bundle and learn journeying and ceremony, with advanced weekends later on.
courses.price: $500 USD per weekend (meals and lodging not included)

courses.title: One-Day Shamanism Basics
courses.description: A day outdoors near Salida introducing where shamanism comes from and how it is practised now. The group tries journeying to meet helping spirits and some simple breath and energy practices, and the day ends with a fire ceremony.

courses.title: One-Day Shamanic Journeying
courses.description: A one-day workshop near Salida devoted to shamanic journeying. Participants make at least four journeys, to the lower, middle and upper worlds, practise breathwork and close with a fire ceremony.

free_resources.title: Jerri Doran on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free recorded shamanic journeys to the lower and upper worlds, angel and guide meditations and a short overview of what journeying involves. Anyone can listen in the app or a browser.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 3.5k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube 1.77K (channel header next to @shamanwings, 1 Nov 2026); Facebook 334 (og:description of facebook.com/shamanwings, 1 Nov 2026) → ~5.6k total → local_hero
flags: Health: her healing-services page describes diagnosing the energy body, working with the physical body and restoring it to health, and her listening-links page says two meditations help with anxiety and depression. Sessions are mentioned in the bio without claims, but not listed as an offering; the listening-links page is not linked. The brand overall is shamanic, not sold on conditions, but a human may want to confirm she passes the strict health rule.
Healing-services page also mentions removing hexes, curses and entities; not repeated anywhere in the plan.

Several kept YouTube titles say 'Guided Healing Meditation' (general healing, no condition named); 'Upper World Shamanic Plant Spirit Journey' is a guided visualisation, not plant medicine. Both kept, worth a glance.
Last Insight Timer upload was about 2 years ago and her newest YouTube video is 3 years old, but she has workshops dated Nov 2026 to 2028, so she is still teaching.
The two one-day workshops are dated 14 and 15 Nov 2026 and will expire soon after listing.
Second photo is a travel shot at Moray, Peru, wearing sunglasses; it matches her headshot but is not a close portrait.
left_out: Private healing sessions ($120 USD an hour): page describes diagnosis and restoring the physical body; health-claim rule.
Listening Links page: descriptions say meditations help with anxiety, stress and depression.
YouTube: 'Guided Shamanic Pachamama Mother Earth Meditation for Grounding, Relaxation and Releasing Stress' (stress-relief framing) and rattle/drum-only tracks (music only).
Home, land and business clearings, spirit clearing and ceremonies: services rather than teaching, mentioned briefly in the bio.
No books found; no Insight Timer courses on her profile.
